Plan (sub-questions with faithful answers): [{"q": "How many hand-crafted templates were constructed for the Freebase evaluation on 500 randomly selected triples?", "answer": "The paper reports 106 hand-crafted templates for the 500 Freebase triples.", "quote": "For the 500 triples, we hand-crafted 106 templates, as these triples share only 53 distinct predicates (we made 2 templates for each predicate on average).", "section": "4.1 Evaluation on Freebase", "importance": 10}, {"q": "How many hand-crafted templates were constructed for the in-house power tool domain knowledge base?", "answer": "The paper reports 163 hand-crafted templates for the in-house power tool domain KB.", "quote": "For the 67 predicates, we hand-craft 163 templates.", "section": "4.3 Evaluation on the Domain-specific KB", "importance": 10}, {"q": "What knowledge base element was each hand-crafted template associated with?", "answer": "Each hand-crafted template was associated with a predicate in the knowledge base.", "quote": "a small set of question templates is first constructed such that each template is associated with a predicate", "section": "3 System", "importance": 7}, {"q": "What was the only human labor required in the proposed system?", "answer": "The only human labor in the work was question template construction.", "quote": "The only human labor in this work is the question template construction.", "section": "1 Introduction", "importance": 6}, {"q": "How many seed questions were generated by applying the templates in the Freebase experiment?", "answer": "991 seed questions were generated by applying the templates in the Freebase experiment.", "quote": "991 seed questions are generated by applying the templates on the triples, and 1529 more questions are retrieved from Google.", "section": "4.1 Evaluation on Freebase", "importance": 4}]

Third-party research note: Question Generation from a Knowledge Base with Web Exploration

Key questions addressed: Question Generation from a Knowledge Base with Web Exploration 106 hand-crafted templates | 106 templates 500 triples Freebase question generation web exploration | 163 templates 67 predicates power tool domain knowledge base question generation | hand-crafted question templates predicates Freebase 53 distinct predicates | only human labor question template construction question generation knowledge base

The paper reports 106 hand-crafted templates for the Freebase evaluation on 500 randomly selected triples. The 500 triples share only 53 distinct predicates, so the authors made 2 templates for each predicate on average. This template set is the human-authored resource used to turn knowledge base triples into natural-language questions. The Freebase evaluation uses these templates as the basis for question generation from a knowledge base with web exploration.

For the in-house power tool domain knowledge base, the paper reports 163 hand-crafted templates for the 67 predicates. These templates serve the same role: each hand-crafted template is associated with a predicate in the knowledge base. The system first constructs a small set of question templates such that each template is associated with a predicate. The only human labor in this work is the question template construction. This manual step covers both the Freebase evaluation and the domain-specific evaluation.

In the Freebase experiment, 991 seed questions are generated by applying the templates on the triples. The paper states that 1529 more questions are retrieved from Google. The template construction counts define the manual effort required to support question generation. The reported numbers are 106 templates for 500 Freebase triples and 163 templates for 67 power tool domain predicates.
